brief_title: Foundational research on AI tooling for market researchers
brief_content: We are running a wave of foundational research on AI tooling for market and consumer insights researchers. Objective: understand the specific failure modes that have burned researchers in client-facing work, the guardrails they would need to see before adopting AI tooling, and the differences in adoption appetite between agency and in-house teams. Audience: senior insights professionals at agencies and in-house corporate teams across India, the UK, Singapore, and the US.
